ly_do_dat: Khong co loi nang. Dat = false vi con mot tham chieu chet (Table S6 tro toi 'Table S2', nay la bang closed-form) va mot so cho doi nghia/mat rao muc vua.

khoa.nhan_xet_la: 26 muc la deu hop le: trich dan so moi trong manuscript_numbered.md ([3,4],[8,9],[11-13],[18-20],[29-31],[15,26],[29-31,37],[38,39],[41,42]) khop voi danh sach 42 muc va voi ban author-year; 'Fig. 1)'...'Fig. 7b)', 'Table 2)', 'Section 5.3)' la so moi dung theo figure_map.md; S16, S17 la Fig. S16/S17 moi (ban ghi Gie Cuc, Phuong Do) dung; (Deng et al., 2025), (Yan et al., 2022), (Fryba, 1999), (Sohn, 2007; Cross et al., 2013) la trich dan author-year trong phu luc, deu co trong danh sach chinh.
khoa.canh_bao_rao: 'could' 4 -> 1 va 'can' 13 -> 12: mat 'invariance ... could be shown only within margins of 10-27 %' o Abstract (xem phat hien V3); Ket luan 4 van giu y qua 'within the 10-27 % that the noise resolves'.

phat_hien.vi_tri: | 2, lane B, average | 0.749 (0.440–1.276) | – (constants fail the χ² test, Table S2) |
phat_hien.van_de: Tham chieu chet sau khi danh so lai: Table S2 cu (hang so tich phan va chi^2) nay la Table S5; Table S2 moi la bang vi tri toi uu ba nhip.

phat_hien.vi_tri: the standard deviation of the load falls from 24.8 % with N7 alone to 10.6 % with the pair, an upper bound because such common-mode behaviour need not hold during crossings (Section 4.3).
phat_hien.van_de: Doi nghia khi gop cau. v4 viet 'these gains are upper bounds'; ban moi gan 'an upper bound' vao gia tri 10.6 %, tuc noi do lech chuan toi da la 10.6 %, trong khi thuc ra 10.6 % la gia tri lac quan (can duoi cua do lech chuan).
phat_hien.de_xuat: '... to 10.6 % with the pair; this gain is an upper bound, because such common-mode behaviour need not hold during crossings (Section 4.3).'

phat_hien.vi_tri: A laboratory test confirms the identity, and public moving-truck records are consistent with its assumptions; they also show that vehicle-free noise covariance misleads multi-channel weighting.
phat_hien.van_de: Abstract mat hai cau rao cua v4: 'invariance of the constant could be shown only within margins of 10-27 %' va 'the narrow range of reference weights did not allow weight discrimination to be tested'. Ket luan cung bo cau 'the reference weights varied too little for any estimator to beat the mean weight'. Gioi han nay nay chi con o §4.3 va §6.
phat_hien.de_xuat: '... public moving-truck records are consistent with its assumptions within margins of 10–27 % but could not test weight discrimination; they also show ...'

phat_hien.vi_tri: 5. A residual offset of 0.1 mm biases a 25 t truck by 16–25 % even at mid main span.
phat_hien.van_de: Mat pham vi khi tach thanh ket luan rieng. Trong v4 cau nay nam trong ket luan 5 ve dam 55 + 90 + 55 m, voi L_tot = 200 m, tren tap chap nhan duoc, va viet 'would bias'. Dung mot minh, no thanh mot khang dinh chung cho moi dam.
phat_hien.de_xuat: '5. On that girder, with a 200 m record, a residual offset of 0.1 mm would bias a 25 t truck by 16–25 % even at mid main span.' (hoac nhap lai vao ket luan 3).

phat_hien.vi_tri: strain influence lines cancel less than deflection influence lines (cancellation ratio $R_\varepsilon = 0.667$ against $R_w = 0.571$ at mid-span of two equal spans)
phat_hien.van_de: Pham vi bi noi rong. v4 §2.3 viet 'it cancels less at every prismatic location examined'; ban moi bo pham vi nay o §2.3 va o phan dong gop lai phat bieu nhu mot quy luat chung.
phat_hien.de_xuat: 'strain influence lines cancel less than deflection influence lines at every prismatic location examined (...)'; o §2.3 khoi phuc cau 'The strain influence line is more local ..., so it cancels less at every prismatic location examined:' truoc so 0.667/0.571.

phat_hien.vi_tri: The quasi-static error for a constant force is at most about 1 % when $t_\mathrm{cr}/T_1 \ge 8$ (crossing time over fundamental period; Frýba, 1999); other terms are in Supplementary Section S10.
phat_hien.van_de: Mat pham vi va rao: v4 noi 'for a constant force moving across the laboratory beam' va 'This bound omits vehicle–bridge interaction and road roughness'. Hai y nay con o S9 nhung chinh van gio phat bieu chung, va lai tro toi S10 trong khi phan dong luc hoc nam o S9.
phat_hien.de_xuat: 'For a constant force crossing the laboratory beam, the quasi-static error is at most about 1 % when ... (Frýba, 1999); the bound omits vehicle–bridge interaction and road roughness (Supplementary Sections S9 and S10).'

phat_hien.vi_tri: (Moghadam et al., 2023, J. Struct. Integr. Maint.)
phat_hien.van_de: Khoa trich dan khong khop danh sach Sage Harvard (co 2023a va 2023b); viet kem ten tap chi la khong chuan.

phat_hien.vi_tri: non-contact techniques must establish their residual offset on site (Sohn, 2007; Cross et al., 2013)
phat_hien.van_de: Khi rut gon, menh de 'since environmental effects act over the same window' bi bo. Hai nguon nay (tac dong moi truong/van hanh; theo doi dai han cau Tamar) ung ho y do, khong truc tiep ung ho y 'non-contact techniques must...'.
phat_hien.de_xuat: '... must establish their residual offset on site, because environmental effects act over the same window (Sohn, 2007; Cross et al., 2013).'

phat_hien.vi_tri: show on public moving-truck records that GLS weights built from vehicle-free noise raise the out-of-sample error above that of the gauge average (20.4 % against 11.9 % of gross weight)
phat_hien.van_de: Ket qua chi dung cho ngay 2 (ngay 1 khong phan biet duoc). Ket luan 4 va Abstract ('misleads multi-channel weighting') cung vay; v4 da thieu pham vi nay o Ket luan 3, nen day khong hoan toan do lan sua.
phat_hien.de_xuat: Them 'on day 2' / 'on one of the two test days' o phan dong gop (ii) va Ket luan 4.

phat_hien.vi_tri: The two runs with the trucks one behind the other gave 0.92 of the summed single-truck predictions
phat_hien.van_de: Mat chu ngu pham vi 'For the gauge average' cua v4; 0.92 la gia tri cua trung binh cac gauge.
phat_hien.de_xuat: 'For the gauge average, the two runs ...'.

phat_hien.vi_tri: If a model-based constant is wanted ... / Abstract: "a pier tiltmeter is the most informative additional measurement"
phat_hien.van_de: Abstract bo dieu kien 'If a model-based constant is wanted' ma §5.3 van giu.
phat_hien.de_xuat: '... and, if a model-based constant is wanted, a pier tiltmeter is the most informative additional measurement.'

phat_hien.vi_tri: **Fig. 1.** Continuous beams considered: (a) two-span beam with span ratio $\lambda$, rigidity ratio $\gamma$ and sensor at $\xi L_1$; (b) ...
phat_hien.van_de: Bang ky hieu da chuyen sang phu luc va chu thich nay bo dinh nghia L_1 (nhip co dat sensor), EI_1, L_2 = lambda L_1, EI_2 = gamma EI_1, L_side, L_main = beta L_side, EI_main = gamma EI_side. Hinh ve van ghi cac nhan nay nen nguoi doc van tra duoc, nhung chinh van khong noi nhip 1 la nhip co dat sensor. L (§2.2) va x_m cung chua duoc dinh nghia truoc khi dung.
phat_hien.de_xuat: Khoi phuc chu thich Fig. 1 cua v4, hoac them o §2.2: 'with L_1 the instrumented span'.

phat_hien.van_de: Mat 'with a mid side-span sensor': vong tron danh dau sensor o giua nhip bien, khong phai gauge N8 da lap o 0.4L, nen de doc nham. Cung bo 'Colours are clipped at ±1.5'.
phat_hien.de_xuat: 'Cầu Mây layout with a mid side-span sensor (open circle); colours clipped at ±1.5'.

phat_hien.vi_tri: **Fig. 5.** Ratio of the integral constants of two trucks, per gauge and gauge average
phat_hien.van_de: Mat thong tin: tren panel (a), trung binh gauge ngay 1 la trung binh cua 4 gauge vet banh, khong phai 12 gauge (khac voi Table 2, nơi 'Day 1, 12 gauges').
phat_hien.de_xuat: '(a) day 1, ..., 12 gauges and the average of the four wheel-path gauges; (b) day 2, ..., 4 gauges and their average'.

phat_hien.vi_tri: By $N_M$ alone the best strain locations are 5–10 m from the piers ($|N_M| \ge 0.39$)
phat_hien.van_de: Mat pham vi 'in all haunched models'.

phat_hien.vi_tri: Its left-hand side is the indicator $N_w$ of Eq. (10).
phat_hien.van_de: Bo dieu kien 'with EI_ref = EI'; tren dam khong lang tru N_w phu thuoc EI_ref, va chinh van nhan manh dieu nay o §2.3.
phat_hien.de_xuat: 'Its left-hand side is the indicator $N_w$ of Eq. (10) with $EI_\mathrm{ref} = EI$.'

phat_hien.vi_tri: The SLM deviations match the growth of the measured-to-analytical integral ratio (1.010, 1.016 and 1.017 for one, two and three loads)
phat_hien.van_de: Bo 'relative to its one-load value of 1.010'; 0.61 % va 0.70 % khop voi muc tang so voi 1.010, khong khop voi chinh cac ty so.
phat_hien.de_xuat: '... match the growth of this ratio relative to its one-load value (1.010, 1.016 and 1.017 ...)'.

phat_hien.vi_tri: beam model still reproduces the global shape of the strain histories ($r^2$ = 0.79–0.94)
phat_hien.van_de: r^2 khong duoc dinh nghia trong chinh van (chi co trong Table S1). Ky hieu \bar C o Eq. (14) cung chua duoc dinh nghia (loi co tu v4).
phat_hien.de_xuat: Dinh nghia r^2 (coefficient of determination) va \bar C (mean of the C_j) tai cho dung lan dau.
